hint_ladder.title: Common Difference
hint_ladder.text: Hanapin ang difference: 7-3=4, 11-7=4, 15-11=4, 19-15=4. Pare-pareho ang 4, kaya 'yan ang common difference.

hint_ladder.title: Arithmetic Sequence
hint_ladder.text: Kapag constant ang difference, arithmetic sequence 'yan. Ang formula: a_n = a_1 + (n-1)d, pero mas madali, add lang ang d sa huli.

hint_ladder.title: Find the Next Term
hint_ladder.text: Huling term ay 19. I-add ang common difference: 19 + 4 = ?. Simple lang, parang pagbilang ng steps.

hint_ladder.title: Answer
hint_ladder.text: 19 + 4 = 23. Kaya ang sagot ay 23, na nasa Option C. Tama, guaranteed!

A.text: You might have chosen 21 because you added 2 instead of 4, but the real difference is 4.

B.text: You might have chosen 22 because you mistakenly added 3 to 19, but the constant addition is 4.

C.text: Correct. The constant addition of 4 makes the next term 23 (19+4).

D.text: You might have chosen 24 because you added 5, thinking the pattern changed, but it's always +4.

next_time_rule: Next time: Una, hanapin ang common difference. Kung pare-pareho, arithmetic sequence — add mo lang 'yun sa huling term para makuha ang susunod. Simple!
deconstruct_text:
Si Barangay Tanod Rolly, consistent mag-ipon. Monday, ₱3; Tuesday, ₱7; Wednesday, ₱11; Thursday, ₱15; Friday, ₱19. Pansinin mo, laging dagdag na ₱4 bawat araw. Ibig sabihin, arithmetic sequence ito na may common difference na 4.

Para malaman ang savings sa Saturday, i-add mo lang ang common difference sa huling halaga: ₱19 + ₱4 = ₱23. Kaya ang sagot ay ₱23. Ang dali, 'di ba? Parang pagbilang ng hakbang, step by step lang.

Kapag nakakita ka ng sequence na pare-pareho ang dagdag o bawas, arithmetic 'yan. Huwag ka nang maguluhan sa ibang pattern. Siguradong tama ang sagot mo kung mag-add ka lang ng difference sa huling term.
